name: Dark Star Rhaast x Dota 2 Killstreaks Announcer
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

This mod uses the original Dark Star Rhaast announcer combined with killstreak and multikill voice lines from Dota 2.

Imported voice lines were adjusted to better fit League's announcer system.

---

### Dark Star Rhaast announcements

Includes base announcer lines along with additional Rhaast lines from the Odyssey Kayn skin.

• Your inhibitor respawn → Rhaast laughs maniacally.  
• Enemy inhibitor respawn → May the violence never end!  

---

### Dota 2 killstreak & multikill announcements

*(original League announcements → Dota 2 replacements)*

**Multikills**

• First Blood → First Blood  
• Double Kill → Double Kill  
• Triple Kill → Triple Kill  
• Quadra Kill → Ultra Kill  
• Penta Kill → Rampage  

**Killstreaks**

• Killing Spree → Killing Spree  
• Rampage → Mega Kill  

*(Dota 2 Rampage was intentionally NOT used here because in Dota 2 it represents a Pentakill-equivalent killstreak rather than a regular streak tier.)*

• Dominating → Dominating  
• Unstoppable → Unstoppable  
• Godlike → Godlike / Monster Kill  
• Legendary → Ownage / Holy Shit / Wicked Sick
